run_metaicl_training: run the MetaICL training loop on a specified task using GPT-2 with configurable hyperparameters
tensorize_training_data: tensorize training data for a MetaICL task using the GPT-2 tokenizer and save to disk
load_and_train_model: load a GPT-2 checkpoint and train it on in-context learning data with AdamW optimization
configure_distributed_training: configure distributed GPU training with FP16 support and configurable batch size and learning rate
setup_optimizer_and_parallelize: setup the optimizer with warmup steps and parallelize the model across multiple GPUs
